INSERT INTO demand_matches(id, subscription_id, product_id, score, reason_codes) VALUES
(#{m.id,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{m.subscriptionId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{productId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{m.score}, #{m.reasonCodes}::text[])
ON CONFLICT (subscription_id, product_id) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, reason_codes = EXCLUDED.reason_codes, invalidated_at = NULL
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, b.name AS building_name, b.zone AS building_zone, , te.normalized_isbn AS sub_textbook_isbn, te.title AS sub_textbook_title, te.edition_label AS sub_textbook_edition_label, s.textbook_edition_id AS sub_textbook_edition_id, m.id AS match_id, m.score AS match_score, m.reason_codes AS match_reason_codes, m.read_at AS match_read_at, m.invalidated_at AS match_invalidated_at, m.created_at AS match_created_at, s.id AS sub_id, s.keyword AS sub_keyword, s.category AS sub_category, s.min_price AS sub_min_price, s.max_price AS sub_max_price, s.geo_scope AS sub_geo_scope, s.campus_id AS sub_campus_id, s.building_id AS sub_building_id, sb.zone AS sub_zone, sb.name AS sub_building_name FROM demand_matches m JOIN demand_subscriptions s ON s.id = m.subscription_id JOIN products p ON p.id = m.product_id LEFT JOIN buildings b ON b.id = p.building_id LEFT JOIN textbook_editions te ON te.id = s.textbook_edition_id LEFT JOIN buildings sb ON sb.id = s.building_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND m.dismissed_at IS NULL AND product_visible_to(p.id, p.visibility, p.seller_id, p.campus, p.moderation_hidden_at, s.user_id) ORDER BY m.created_at DESC, m.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
